summary: Aurora runs omnichannel contact centers for retail clients. Primary interest: real-time agent assist (streaming inline suggestions), automated ticket summarization post-call, and safe tool-calling into their CRM/ticketing system. Key constraints: sub-200ms end-to-end suggestion SLO, deterministic behavior under spikes (up to 2k concurrent agent sessions during campaigns), strict EU data residency for EU customers, strong guardrails to prevent PII leakage and unauthorized CRM writes. Preference for Dedicated pool with VPC/private control plane; willing to pilot hosted API first for feature validation. Quantization/optimize recommendations important for unit cost.
notes: Notes from demo: showed streaming token-by-token suggestions in UI. They liked prefix caching idea. SE asked about KV cache eviction during long calls.
Aurora: 'We need suggestions that don't lag — agents must see completions within a keystroke. 150ms would be ideal, 250ms max.'
POC success metrics: median suggestion latency <200ms, 99th percentile <400ms during 2k spike test; reduction in average handle time (AHT) by 15% in pilot; summary accuracy F1 >= 0.78 on labeled set.
Tool-calling: must support allowlist of API endpoints, audit logs for each call, per-call approval flow in UI for high-risk actions (e.g., refunds).
Guardrails: entity-level redaction for PII, suppression rules, hallucination detection alerts, human-in-loop fallback for risky suggestions.
Scaling/ops ask: autoscale decisions by request rate and active agents, burst capacity to handle seasonal marketing spikes, circuit-breaker to route to simpler model variant under overload.
Security notes: require SSO (Okta), SAML integration examples, KMS integration for key wrapping, retention control — 30/90/365 day options, need audit logs forwarded to SIEM (Splunk).
Commercial: prefer committed Dedicated capacity if SLA and predictable unit cost can be demonstrated. Will consider Private on-prem for EU-regulated clients after pilot.

Open questions: 1) exact latency numbers in hosted vs dedicated; 2) how caching affects consistency of suggestions; 3) cost model for streaming tokens vs batch summaries; 4) timeline for SOC2 docs upload.
